description: This file contains unit tests for the SecurePrefs class in an Android application, verifying persistence and migration of preferences related to location mode and gateway tokens.

classes.name: SecurePrefsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SecurePrefs, testing preferences migration and persistence functionality.

methods.name: loadLocationMode_migratesLegacyAlwaysValue

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken_persistsSeparatelyFromSharedToken
